title.en: At the bus stop in Keswick

setting.sl: Dopoldne na avtobusni postaji v Keswicku. V Grasmere bi se {m:peljal|f:peljala} z avtobusom 555, ki vozi skozi Grasmere do Amblesida in Windermera. Ob tebi čaka domačinka z nakupovalno torbo.
setting.de: Vormittags an der Bushaltestelle in Keswick. Du willst mit dem Bus 555 nach Grasmere; er fährt über Grasmere nach Ambleside und Windermere. Neben dir wartet eine Frau aus der Gegend mit einer Einkaufstasche.
setting.it: In mattinata alla fermata dell'autobus a Keswick. Vuoi andare a Grasmere con l'autobus 555, che passa per Grasmere e va ad Ambleside e Windermere. Accanto a te aspetta una signora del posto con la borsa della spesa.
setting.en: Late morning at the bus stop in Keswick. You want to take the 555 bus to Grasmere; it goes on through Grasmere to Ambleside and Windermere. A local woman with a shopping bag is waiting next to you.

role: Mrs Relph, a retired local waiting for the 555 with her shopping. Friendly and talkative, knows every bus: the 555 comes about every hour, takes about half an hour to Grasmere, and you buy a single or a return from the driver. Simple, kind British English with a light northern touch ("love").

who.en: A woman at the bus stop

speaker: grandma

goals.en: Ask if the bus to Grasmere stops here

goals.en: Ask when the next bus comes
